article_content: Asiana Airlines has been penalized $500,000 by the U.S. government because of their handling of the San Francisco plane crash in 2013. The penalty follows complaints that families of the victims were initially forced to use an automated phone system to get updates. It took the airline five days to personally reach out to all 291 passengers' families after the crash. This delay and impersonal communication sparked criticism regarding the airline's response. The U.S. Department of Transportation imposed the fine for violations of regulations that mandate prompt and substantial aid to the families of those affected by airline disasters. The tragic accident, which occurred on July 6 near San Francisco, resulted in three deaths and many injuries when Asiana Flight 214 hit a seawall while landing. Transportation Secretary Anthony Foxx stated that families should not have to struggle to get information from the airline during such a trying period. Many affected families resided in South Korea or China, relying on the airline as their primary information source from across the globe. Asiana has stated that they provided considerable assistance to passengers and their families following the accident and plan to continue doing so. Asiana will pay $400,000 as a fine and receive a $100,000 credit for sponsoring training events related to the incident until 2015. The National Transportation Safety Board is still investigating what caused the crash. A consent order stated that the crash happened on a holiday weekend, contributing to understaffing and a slower response. Some families have filed lawsuits against the airline in federal court. The U.S. government started requiring airlines to dedicate resources to families after previous incidents of airlines failing to provide necessary support after plane crashes. Robert A. Jensen from Kenyon International Emergency Services mentioned that some airlines aren't taking family assistance plans seriously. He added, 'It's time that some of the airlines that have been flying under the radar be held accountable,' indicating satisfaction that Asiana was penalized.

article_content: By Sam Webb PUBLISHED: 11:41 EST, 6 March 2013 | UPDATED: 04:55 EST, 7 March 2013 An advert that uses the 'Harlem Shake' internet craze to raise awareness of Parkinson's disease has sparked controversy because it features a sufferer staggering as the music plays. The Dutch Parkinson's Society released the video, called 'Worst Shake Ever', that shows society chairman Eric Roos, who intentionally did not take his medication to make the video, shaking uncontrollably in an office kitchen while the song 'Harlem Shake' by Baauer plays. The video imitates the Harlem Shake internet meme, which involves short videos typically beginning with one person gently bopping alone for the first 15 seconds while everyone else in the room ignores them. Then the bass line drops and everyone goes wild, doing crazy dance moves around the room. Scroll down for video The Dutch Parkinson's Society has released a spoof Harlem Shake video to raise awareness of the debilitating effects of the disease. Society chairman Eric Roos (right) starts shaking as the music plays. In this version, when the bass drops, Mr. Roos collapses and people in the office rush to help him. The clip, created by advertising agency Saatchi & Saatchi, ends with the slogan: 'Shaking, fun for some… daily struggle for others.' A statement on the charity's website said: 'With this, the society and its chairman want to show that Parkinson's is much more than a shaking hand or foot. 'The intention of the video is that it shocks the viewer, because a lot of people don't know what the daily reality of Parkinson's is.' Online observers had mixed reactions to the video. Some felt it was in poor taste, but many others felt it was a bold and effective way of spreading awareness of the condition. Gawker user MichRo99 posted: 'This is horrible,' while Kathy's Crown said: 'So, I have PD (Parkinson's disease) and my father died from the same a year ago last Saturday. I can't even...' Some say the publicity stunt is tasteless, but others defended it as a clever and memorable way of showing what the disease does to people. Collapse: The video ends with Mr. Roos falling to the floor before his colleagues rush to his aid. Message: The society says it wants to challenge the misconception that Parkinson's is simply a shaking hand or foot. However, Miss Norma Desmond said: 'I don't understand how people feel that this is making fun of people with PD (Parkinson's disease) when people with PD obviously participated in making it. Are they not allowed to do anything except be tragic all the time?' Another user, called Cerne, said: 'Wait. When did it become offensive for a disease advocacy group to demonstrate the effects of that disease?' The video has since been removed because of copyright issues with the music company that owns the rights to the song used. The Harlem Shake was created by a group of teenage boys on the Sunshine Coast of Australia. Parkinson's disease is a chronic neurological disorder. People with the condition don't have enough of a chemical called dopamine because some nerve cells in their brain have died. This affects the way the brain co-ordinates the movements of the muscles in different parts of the body. The disease mainly develops in people over 50. About 5 in 1,000 people in their 60s, and about 40 in 1,000 people in their 80s have the condition. The main symptoms are slowness of movement, stiffness of muscles, and shaking. These tend to slowly worsen with time, although the rate varies from patient to patient. The condition is diagnosed from the symptoms shown by the patient. It also increases your risk of dementia. About half of people with PD develop dementia at some stage. Depression is also common among sufferers. There is currently no cure. Drugs and physiotherapy can treat symptoms. There have also been recent promising trials using deep brain stimulation. For more information on Parkinson's, visit www.parkinsons.org.uk. In this Harlem Shake, called 'Shakes on a Plane,' a lone man dances in the aisle of an airplane... ... before the entire cabin joins in wearing a variety of wacky costumes.

article_content: The captain of the fishing vessel 'Ocean Way,' James Noble, 45, has died following an incident in the North Sea. Rescuers confirmed that Noble, from Fraserburgh, Aberdeenshire, was the skipper when the trawler encountered trouble. He was airlifted to a hospital yesterday via RAF helicopter but succumbed to his injuries. Two other crewmen, ages 32 and 38, remain missing after the incident off the Northumberland Coast, and the search has been suspended. The two survivors, men aged 38 and 28, received treatment for hypothermia at Wansbeck Hospital in Northumberland before being discharged. Reports indicate that four other crew members, in addition to Mr. Noble, are of Filipino origin. The Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) stated that the search for the remaining crew members yielded no results. Helicopters and merchant vessels conducted searches Sunday but found no sign of the missing men, and the search has been called off. The 'Ocean Way' sent a mayday signal on Sunday afternoon, prompting a search and rescue operation for the skipper and crew. In total, three individuals, including Captain Noble, were rescued from the water. An RAF rescue helicopter and a Norwegian helicopter were dispatched to assist in the search. The Humber Coastguard reported the vessel was last heard from roughly 100 miles east of the Farne Islands and had sailed from Tynemouth before transmitting an emergency beacon. Bertie Armstrong, chief executive of the Scottish Fishermen's Federation, conveyed sadness over the tragic news and extended sympathies to the families and friends of the crew. Richard Lochhead, Scotland's Fisheries Minister, also expressed sorrow and acknowledged the dangers faced by fishermen.

Hy is gister per RAF-helikopter na 'n hospitaal gehaas, maar het aan sy beserings beswyk. Bertie Armstrong, uitvoerende hoof van die Scottish Fishermen's Federation, het sy hartseer oor die tragiese nuus betuig en sy medelye met die families en vriende van die bemanning betuig. Richard Lochhead, die Skotse minister van visserye, het ook sy leedwese uitgespreek en die gevare wat vissermanne in die gesig staar, erken.

In the Capital One Cup semi-final, Chelsea will compete against Liverpool, while Tottenham will play Sheffield United.

article_content: Retired wrestler Randy 'Macho Man' Savage, age 58, passed away in Seminole, Florida, on Friday morning after his Jeep crashed into a tree, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. His wife, Barbara L. Poffo, 56, a passenger in the vehicle, sustained injuries but is expected to recover, stated Sgt. Steve Gaskins. Born Randall Mario Poffo, Savage gained fame in professional wrestling. The accident occurred on Florida State Route 694 in Pinellas County. The Highway Patrol suggests a possible medical issue may have caused Poffo to lose control of his 2009 Jeep Wrangler, resulting in the collision. An autopsy is pending to confirm this. The report detailed that his vehicle crossed the median and collided with a tree. Poffo was pronounced dead at Largo Medical Center. Remembered for his wrestling career and iconic catchphrases such as 'Ooooooh Yeaahhhhh!' and 'Can you dig it?', Savage later became known for his Slim Jim commercials. Both WWE and ConAgra Foods, the maker of Slim Jim, expressed their condolences. WWE acknowledged Savage's significant contributions, highlighting his championships and impact. ConAgra Foods mourned the loss of their longtime brand ambassador.

article_content: A German solar energy firm, Belectric, is planning a solar farm in the scenic Cotswolds, sparking local opposition. Residents object, fearing impacts on landscape, tourism, and property values. The 25-acre solar farm could power 1,500 homes. Landowner Ronan Lynch says the land's poor soil justifies the project. Belectric claims the installation will be discreet and avoid prime farmland. Local council members will decide on the project in May. Government subsidies have increased solar farms in Britain, according to Ofgem.

article_content: Conservative businessman Christopher Luxon and his centre-right National Party are set to form the next government in New Zealand after a major election victory. With nearly all votes counted on Saturday, the National Party secured about 40 percent of the vote, positioning it to form a new administration with its preferred coalition partner, the libertarian ACT Party, which received nine percent of the vote. Outgoing Prime Minister Chris Hipkins, who served only nine months after succeeding Jacinda Ardern in January, conceded to Luxon late Saturday. While the exact composition of Luxon’s government remains to be determined as ballot counting continues, his victory signifies a significant shift after six years of a liberal government largely led by Ardern, who resigned citing a lack of energy for the role. “Based on tonight’s results, the National Party will be in a position to lead the next government,” Luxon, a former executive who previously led Air New Zealand and entered politics just three years ago, told supporters in Auckland amidst enthusiastic applause. “We will make this an even better country,” he stated, reiterating his commitment to get the country “back on track”. Ardern and the liberals won the previous election decisively, but her approval ratings declined due to extended COVID-19 restrictions and high inflation impacting voter sentiment. Hipkins, her 45-year-old successor, formerly served as education minister and headed the coronavirus pandemic response. In Saturday’s election, the Labour Party under Hipkins secured just over 25 percent of the vote, approximately half of what it received in the previous election under Ardern. Labour also faces the potential loss of Ardern’s former electorate seat in Mount Albert, a long-held liberal stronghold. Foreign Minister Nanaia Mahuta also lost her constituency seat and will not return to parliament. Luxon has pledged to cut taxes for middle-income earners, address inflation, eliminate sales taxes on fruits and vegetables, and reduce crime. Luxon may require support from the populist New Zealand First Party in addition to the ACT Party, given his slim majority. The final vote count will be revealed after overseas and special votes are tallied in early November.

Uittredende Eerste Minister Chris Hipkins, wat slegs nege maande gedien het nadat hy Jacinda Ardern in Januarie opgevolg het, het laat Saterdag aan Luxon toegegee. Terwyl die presiese samestelling van Luxon se regering nog bepaal moet word soos die stemme steeds getel word, beteken sy oorwinning 'n beduidende verskuiwing ná ses jaar van 'n liberale regering wat grootliks deur Ardern gelei is, wat bedank het omdat sy 'n gebrek aan energie vir die rol gehad het. “Op grond van vanaand se uitslae sal die Nasionale Party in 'n posisie wees om die volgende regering te lei,” het Luxon, 'n voormalige bestuurder wat voorheen Air Nieu-Seeland gelei het en slegs drie jaar gelede die politiek betree het, aan ondersteuners in Auckland te midde van entoesiastiese applous gesê. “Ons sal hierdie 'n selfs beter land maak,” het hy gesê en sy verbintenis herhaal om die land “terug op die regte pad” te kry. Ardern en die liberale het die vorige verkiesing oorweldigend gewen, maar haar goedkeuringsgraderings het gedaal weens uitgebreide COVID-19-beperkings en hoë inflasie wat kiesersentiment beïnvloed het. Hipkins, haar 45-jarige opvolger, het voorheen as minister van onderwys gedien en die koronaviruspandemie-reaksie gelei. In Saterdag se verkiesing het die Arbeidersparty onder leiding van Hipkins net meer as 25 persent van die stemme verseker, ongeveer die helfte van wat dit in die vorige verkiesing onder Ardern ontvang het. Die Arbeidersparty staar ook die potensiële verlies van Ardern se voormalige kiesafdeling in Mount Albert in die gesig, 'n liberale vesting wat lank reeds bestaan. Minister van Buitelandse Sake, Nanaia Mahuta, het ook haar kiesafdeling verloor en sal nie na die parlement terugkeer nie. Luxon het onderneem om belasting vir middelinkomste-verdieners te verlaag, inflasie aan te spreek, verkoopsbelasting op vrugte en groente uit te skakel en misdaad te verminder. Luxon het moontlik steun nodig van die populêre Nieu-Seeland Eerste Party benewens die ACT Party, gegewe sy klein meerderheid. Die finale stemtelling sal vroeg in November bekend gemaak word nadat oorsese en spesiale stemme getel is.

article_content: Australia is emerging from its strongest La Nina weather pattern on record, a meteorological event that brings either devastating floods or, in the case of its counterpart El Nino, scorching droughts. According to the Australian Bureau of Meteorology, the weather pattern that brought dramatic floods to southern Queensland a year ago—one of the most intense on record—is waning. However, oceans around the eastern seaboard are still warm enough to cause high-pressure systems that dump months of rainfall in a matter of days. 'There was a very slow-moving trough over inland Australia that stretched from the far northwest, through the Northern Territory, and on to the southeast, including New South Wales and Victoria,' said Jenny Sturrock, acting senior meteorologist at the National Meteorological Centre. 'When it meets all that nice warm moisture from the Coral and Tasman Seas, we got several days of heavy rainfall that led to flooding,' she said. 'This type of broad-scale pattern is more conducive to rainfall but it's also exacerbated by short-term meteorological patterns, too.' Scientists are attributing the recent flooding in Australia and the Philippines to La Nina. The weather pattern is part of a natural cycle called the El Nino-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and occurs when cold water builds up on the west coast of the South American continent. Pulled by strong easterly winds, the cold water surges west across the Pacific, creating a 'cold tongue' that pushes warm water and a consequent high-pressure system ahead of it. The resulting weather system—filled with warm, water-laden air—dumps unusually heavy rain when it makes landfall. Its opposite effect, El Nino, is usually marked by wetter weather over South America. Currently, Argentina is in the grip of drought. La Nina occurs at intervals between a few years and a decade and generally lasts for a year or two. The extent to which global warming has contributed to the intensity of the weather pattern is still not known, with records of the event only stretching back 60 years. Nevertheless, the bureau has said the pattern is similar in intensity to La Nina flooding in 1939 and 1950. Long-term weather patterns across Australia are notoriously difficult to forecast, and meteorologists are collecting oral evidence from Aboriginal people to get a better understanding of the continent's weather cycles. The Bureau of Meteorology's Indigenous Weather Knowledge project aims to build a weather map of Australia based on knowledge of weather patterns from Indigenous communities. Under this system, a complex mosaic of weather patterns is being mapped. For example, studies have established that the Aboriginal people of the Sydney region recognized six distinct seasons, rather than the four given to the area by its white settlers.
translated_content: Australië is besig om uit sy sterkste La Nina-weerpatroon op rekord te kom, 'n meteorologiese gebeurtenis wat óf verwoestende vloede bring óf, in die geval van sy teenpool El Nino, versengende droogtes. Volgens die Australiese Buro vir Meteorologie is die weerpatroon wat 'n jaar gelede dramatiese vloede na suidelike Queensland gebring het—een van die intensste op rekord—aan die afneem. Oseane rondom die oostelike kus is egter steeds warm genoeg om hoëdrukstelsels te veroorsaak wat maande se reënval binne 'n kwessie van dae kan stort. 'Daar was 'n baie stadig bewegende trog oor die binneland van Australië wat gestrek het van die verre noordweste, deur die Noordelike Gebied, en na die suidooste, insluitend Nieu-Suid-Wallis en Victoria,' sê Jenny Sturrock, waarnemende senior meteoroloog by die Nasionale Meteorologiese Sentrum. 'Wanneer dit al daardie lekker warm vog van die Koraal- en Tasmansee ontmoet, het ons verskeie dae van swaar reënval gehad wat tot vloede gelei het,' sê sy. 'Hierdie tipe grootskaalse patroon is meer bevorderlik vir reënval, maar dit word ook vererger deur korttermyn meteorologiese patrone.' Wetenskaplikes skryf die onlangse vloede in Australië en die Filippyne toe aan La Nina. Die weerpatroon is deel van 'n natuurlike siklus genaamd die El Nino-Suidelike Ossillasie (ENSO) en vind plaas wanneer koue water opbou aan die weskus van die Suid-Amerikaanse kontinent. Getrek deur sterk oostewinde, stoot die koue water weswaarts oor die Stille Oseaan en skep 'n 'koue tong' wat warm water en 'n gevolglike hoëdrukstelsel voor hom uit stoot. Die gevolglike weerstelsel—gevul met warm, waterbelaaide lug—stort ongewoon swaar reën wanneer dit land bereik. Die teenoorgestelde effek, El Nino, word gewoonlik gekenmerk deur natter weer oor Suid-Amerika. Argentinië is tans in die greep van 'n droogte. La Nina kom voor met tussenposes van 'n paar jaar tot 'n dekade en duur gewoonlik 'n jaar of twee. Die mate waarin aardverwarming bygedra het tot die intensiteit van die weerpatroon is nog nie bekend nie, met rekords van die gebeurtenis wat slegs 60 jaar terugstrek. Nietemin het die buro gesê die patroon is soortgelyk in intensiteit as La Nina-vloede in 1939 en 1950. Langtermyn-weerpatrone regoor Australië is berug moeilik om te voorspel, en meteoroloë samel mondelinge getuienis van Aboriginal-mense in om 'n beter begrip van die vasteland se weersiklusse te kry. Die Buro vir Meteorologie se Inheemse Weerkennisprojek het ten doel om 'n weerkaart van Australië te bou gebaseer op kennis van weerpatrone van Inheemse gemeenskappe. Onder hierdie stelsel word 'n komplekse mosaïek van weerpatrone gekarteer. Studies het byvoorbeeld vasgestel dat die Aboriginal-mense van die Sydney-streek ses afsonderlike seisoene erken, eerder as die vier wat deur sy wit setlaars aan die gebied gegee is.

article_content: Laura Spalding, 27, was overwhelmed when she saw 'Will You Marry Me' spelled out in the grass during a 45-minute glider flight at her local airfield. As a birthday treat, Ian Rawling gifted his girlfriend the flying lesson, secretly planning to propose. The 46-year-old had spent weeks discreetly designing and creating the letters in his living room using 80 metres of wallpaper and string. Ian Rawling proposed to Laura Spalding during her gliding lesson at The Gliding Centre. Despite her emotional reaction, Laura immediately accepted Ian's proposal after landing. The proposal was filmed with the help of Ian's friends at The Gliding Centre in Husbands Bosworth, Leics, last Sunday. Laura, a physiotherapist, recounted: 'For my birthday, Ian drove me to the gliding club. When he turned in, I thought it was a wonderful present because I enjoy adventurous activities. I had been skydiving, but never had the opportunity to fly in a glider, even though I live nearby. The flight was supposed to be half an hour, but it seemed longer. I didn't think much of it being extended because it was my birthday. The pilot, Rob, kept radioing in, and they mentioned the runway was busy, but I didn't suspect anything. I thought he might propose on our upcoming trip, but I never anticipated this. When Rob received clearance, he banked the plane, and I spotted the message on the ground.' Ian proposed by spelling out the words 'Will You Marry Me' with large white letters on the grass of the flying centre as she flew above. 'When I saw 'Will you marry me,' I was shocked. I burst into tears and probably swore. I couldn't believe he had done something so elaborate; I was completely surprised and emotional. Upon landing, Ian was waiting with a beautiful ring. Of course, I said yes. It was a perfect and unforgettable day.' The couple, together for two years after meeting online, plan to marry next year. Computer programmer Ian shared that his plan nearly failed when he had to use knives and forks to secure the letters after running out of tent pegs. Ian, from Northamptonshire, explained: 'I don't know where I got the idea, but I figured she wouldn't expect it on her birthday. I knew she liked gliding, so I booked the lesson and coordinated with the club. They were very helpful and even suggested filming it. I made the letters in my living room. On the day, a club member helped me set up the letters. We almost finished when we ran out of tent pegs and had to improvise with knives and forks from the canteen. I had been hiding the letters in my car all day, and Laura had been in the boot several times. It was difficult concealing all that wallpaper and string. But we managed to get it done, and when she landed, I proposed, and she accepted. She doesn't usually show her emotions outwardly, so her reaction on the video was amazing. I managed to surprise her, which is difficult, so I felt great.' Have you been involved in a romantic proposal? Share your story at femail@mailonline.co.uk.
translated_content: Laura Spalding, 27, was oorweldig toe sy 'Sal Jy Met My Trou' in die gras gespel sien tydens 'n 45-minute sweeftuigvlug by haar plaaslike vliegveld. As 'n verjaarsdagbederf het Ian Rawling sy meisie die vliegles gegee, en in die geheim beplan om haar te vra om te trou. Die 46-jarige het weke lank in die geheim die letters in sy woonkamer ontwerp en geskep met 80 meter se muurpapier en tou. Ian Rawling het Laura Spalding gevra om te trou tydens haar sweefles by Die Sweefsentrum. Ten spyte van haar emosionele reaksie, het Laura onmiddellik Ian se aanbod aanvaar nadat sy geland het. Die aanbod is verfilm met die hulp van Ian se vriende by Die Sweefsentrum in Husbands Bosworth, Leics, verlede Sondag. Laura, 'n fisioterapeut, het vertel: 'Vir my verjaarsdag het Ian my na die sweefklub gery. Toe hy indraai, het ek gedink dit was 'n wonderlike geskenk omdat ek van avontuurlustige aktiwiteite hou. Ek het al gespringskerm, maar nog nooit die geleentheid gehad om in 'n sweeftuig te vlieg nie, al woon ek naby die sentrum. Die vlug was veronderstel om 'n halfuur te wees, maar dit het langer gelyk. Ek het nie veel daarvan gedink dat dit verleng word nie, want dit was my verjaarsdag. Die vlieënier, Rob, het aanhoudend ingeroep, en hulle het genoem die aanloopbaan is besig, maar ek het niks vermoed nie. Ek het gedink hy sou dalk vra om te trou op ons komende reis, maar ek het dit nooit verwag nie. Toe Rob toestemming ontvang het, het hy die vliegtuig gedraai, en ek het die boodskap op die grond gesien.' Ian het voorgestel deur die woorde 'Sal Jy Met My Trou' met groot wit letters op die gras van die vliegsentrum uit te spel terwyl sy bo-oor gevlieg het. 'Toe ek 'Sal jy met my trou' sien, was ek geskok. Ek het in trane uitgebars en waarskynlik gevloek. Ek kon nie glo hy het so iets uitgewerk nie; ek was heeltemal verras en emosioneel. By landing het Ian gewag met 'n pragtige ring. Natuurlik het ek ja gesê. Dit was 'n perfekte en onvergeetlike dag.' Die paartjie, wat twee jaar saam is nadat hulle aanlyn ontmoet het, beplan om volgende jaar te trou. Rekenaarprogrammeerder Ian het gedeel dat sy plan byna misluk het toe hy messe en vurke moes gebruik om die letters vas te maak nadat hy sonder tentpenne klaargekom het. Ian, van Northamptonshire, het verduidelik: 'Ek weet nie waar ek die idee gekry het nie, maar ek het gedink sy sou dit nie op haar verjaarsdag verwag nie. Ek het geweet sy hou van sweef, so ek het die les bespreek en met die klub gekoördineer. Hulle was baie behulpsaam en het selfs voorgestel om dit te verfilm. Ek het die letters in my woonkamer gemaak. Op die dag het 'n klublid my gehelp om die letters op te stel. Ons was amper klaar toe ons sonder tentpenne klaargekom het en moes improviseer met messe en vurke uit die kantien. Ek het die letters die hele dag in my motor weggesteek, en Laura was al verskeie kere in die kattebak. Dit was moeilik om al daardie muurpapier en tou weg te steek. Maar ons het dit reggekry, en toe sy land, het ek gevra, en sy het aanvaar. Sy wys gewoonlik nie haar emosies openlik nie, so haar reaksie op die video was ongelooflik. Ek het daarin geslaag om haar te verras, wat moeilik is, so ek het wonderlik gevoel.' Was jy betrokke by 'n romantiese aanbod? Deel jou storie by femail@mailonline.co.uk.

article_content: In response to the Israel-Gaza conflict, governments worldwide have arranged repatriation flights from Tel Aviv to assist their citizens in leaving Israel. The following is a list of governments that have organized special flights: Australia: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced that two flights were scheduled for Friday and Sunday to repatriate Australian citizens from Israel. Austria: Austrian forces initiated the evacuation of Austrians from Israel on Wednesday. A transport plane, capable of carrying approximately 60 passengers, departed from Horsching airbase in Upper Austria for Cyprus, where Austrians will be transported from Israel. Brazil: The Brazilian embassy in Tel Aviv reported that a third repatriation flight carrying 69 Brazilians departed Israel late on Thursday. This followed previous flights on Wednesday and earlier on Thursday, which carried 212 and 211 passengers, respectively. Two additional flights are planned before Sunday. Canada: Air Canada is set to operate two special flights on Friday and Saturday from Athens to facilitate the return of Canadians and permanent residents from Israel. The Centre for Israel and Jewish Affairs indicated that approximately 1,000 Canadians in Israel wish to leave. Chile: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced via social media on Thursday that a total of 209 Chileans had been evacuated to Athens and Madrid from Israel on three Boeing 737 flights. Colombia: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on social media that an initial flight carrying 110 Colombians landed at the Military Transport Air Command airbase near Bogota on Friday. Cyprus: On Tuesday, a Cypriot ministerial committee activated 'Estia,' a repatriation scheme offering temporary accommodation and assistance to citizens of the European Union and developing countries fleeing crisis zones. Aviation officials reported that 11 extra flights to and from Israel were arranged on Monday, including the scheduled repatriation of approximately 150 Cypriot pilgrims. Czech Republic: Foreign Minister Jan Lipavsky evacuated 34 Czech citizens from Israel on a government plane after visiting the country while returning from a conference in Oman. The Czech government noted that Lipavsky, the first foreign official to visit Israel since the attacks, did not rule out sending another repatriation flight. He arrived in Israel on Tuesday and landed in Prague early on Wednesday. Denmark: A Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson told Reuters that the government provided a C-130 Hercules cargo plane, capable of carrying about 120 passengers, for citizen evacuation. The ministry stated the flight would not operate before Friday. Finland: Jussi Tanner, Director General of Consular Services at the Ministry for Foreign Affairs, announced via social media that the first evacuation flight for Finns from Israel was cancelled due to a technical issue. He added that a joint Swedish-Finnish flight scheduled for Friday, as well as a second Finnish evacuation flight, were still planned. France: Following a special Air France flight on Thursday, France will organize additional repatriation flights from Tel Aviv on Friday and Saturday. Germany: German airline Condor, in coordination with the Federal Foreign Office, plans two flights on Sunday with a total capacity of nearly 500 passengers to evacuate German citizens from Aqaba, Jordan, near the Israeli border. A Foreign Office spokesperson stated on Wednesday that 5,000 Germans had registered to leave Israel, but the ministry could not confirm how many had already departed. Iceland: The Icelandic Ministry of Foreign Affairs reported that a chartered flight carrying 126 Icelanders, five Faroese, four Norwegians, and 12 Germans, along with flight crew and ministry representatives, had departed for Keflavik, Iceland. The Icelandic state chartered and financed the flight. Italy: The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that seven flights were arranged on Tuesday and Wednesday to repatriate approximately 900 Italian citizens from Israel. Mexico: The latest flight repatriating Mexicans from Israel landed on Thursday. The Mexican army is conducting humanitarian flights to bring citizens home, as announced by the government on Monday. President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador stated that approximately 5,000 Mexican nationals are in Israel, and about 300 have requested to leave. Netherlands: Citing the government, Dutch news agency ANP reported that the Netherlands will continue repatriation flights from Israel as long as necessary. The Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs sent a military plane to Israel on Thursday after KLM withdrew its flight offer due to safety concerns. Norway: Norwegian Air cancelled a planned evacuation flight from Tel Aviv to Oslo on Thursday due to a lack of insurance coverage. Poland: President Andrzej Duda announced on Sunday that Poland would send military planes to evacuate its citizens from Israel. Defence Minister Mariusz Blaszczak confirmed that Poland was dispatching two C-130 Hercules planes to evacuate approximately 200 Poles from Ben Gurion Airport. Portugal: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs reported that Portugal's mission to repatriate nationals wishing to leave Israel concluded with the arrival of a Portuguese military aircraft in Lisbon on Thursday, carrying 22 people – eight Portuguese and 14 foreign nationals. South Korea: A Korean Air plane carrying 192 South Koreans from Tel Aviv arrived at Incheon airport near Seoul on Wednesday. Spain: Acting Defence Minister Margarita Robles announced on Tuesday that Spain had sent two military aircraft to Israel to evacuate approximately 500 Spaniards. An Airbus A330 carrying over 200 Spaniards, EU citizens, and nationals from other countries residing in Spain landed at Torrejon de Ardoz military base near Madrid on Wednesday. Switzerland: Swiss citizens were transported from Israel to Zurich on a Swiss International Air Lines flight on Tuesday. Thailand: Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin announced on social media on Monday that evacuations would commence immediately. On Thursday, 15 Thais arrived at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi International Airport from Tel Aviv. Ukraine: Ukrainian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Oleg Nikolenko stated on Facebook that over 1,000 Ukrainian citizens had requested assistance in leaving Israel. He added that a first evacuation flight to Romania would be organized for Saturday. Nikolenko also noted that approximately 200 Ukrainians had requested evacuation from the Gaza Strip, but it was currently too dangerous to proceed. United States: The White House announced that the US Department of State would offer charter flights to help Americans leave Israel starting on Friday. This decision followed extensive discussions with US airlines and pressure from Congress.

article_content: The McRib, a McDonald's favorite from the 1980s, is back for a limited engagement in both Canada and the U.S. Although it briefly graced UK menus in 2002 as part of the McChoice lineup, it was eventually discontinued. This sandwich enjoys a devoted fan base, evident through online communities like the McRib locator map and a Facebook group campaigning for its permanent return. Shortly after its return to U.S. McDonald's locations, a photo of the uncooked McRib began circulating online. The image, apparently taken by a McDonald's employee, showcased the frozen pork patties before the application of barbecue sauce, pickles, and onions. The snapshot quickly gained traction online, sparking debate among McRib enthusiasts regarding whether it dampened their enthusiasm for the product. According to the Huffington Post, comments flooded Reddit soon after the picture, thought to be taken in Canada, appeared. While some offered humorous remarks about the distinctive sandwich, others expressed apprehension about the worker's bare hands touching the food. Despite the image of the frozen McRib, many ardent supporters remained undeterred. One fan noted the production standards appeared surprisingly favorable. McDonald's indicates that the McRib is unlikely to return to the UK menu soon. The sandwich's sporadic availability has solidified its legendary status. This limited availability has fostered a dedicated following and a Facebook group advocating for its comeback. Interestingly, a McRib sighting was reported in Belfast via the McRib locator, a website where fans share pictures and locations of their McRib experiences. The restaurant's website states that customers get more meat due to the absence of bones. However, a consumer report cited by Metro revealed that these 'meat logs' contain approximately 70 ingredients. A 2011 study highlighted that the primary components consist of ground pork trimmings mixed with salt and water. Reactions to the raw McRib photo surged across Twitter. Some users commented on how the photo casts doubts on everything, while others made humorous comparisons. Salon suggested the photo should discourage consumers if the fat content wasn't enough. Conversely, the Facebook McRib Locator Page is filled with fans sharing locations and their consumption counts since the sandwich's return.

article_content: President Barack Obama is advocating for time and vigilance to address problems as deeply rooted in American society as racism and bias. He is also urging patience, stating that progress usually occurs incrementally. In an interview with BET, the President described his conversation with a group of young civil rights activists, including a leader of protests in Ferguson, Missouri, whom he hosted last week in the Oval Office. His comments follow New York Mayor Bill de Blasio's assertion that the United States is confronting 'centuries of racism,' after a week of protests that occurred in major cities across the country. Drawing from personal experience, he expressed concern for his son's safety when interacting with police officers, adding: 'It's different for a white child; it's just a reality in this country.' President Barack Obama is advocating for time and vigilance to address problems as deeply rooted in American society as racism and bias (file picture). Obama stated that he told them that 'this is something that is deeply rooted in our society and in our history.' America has made gains, he said, and that 'gives us hope' for further progress. 'We can't equate what is happening now to what was happening 50 years ago,' Obama said, 'and if you talk to your parents, grandparents, or uncles, they'll tell you that things are better, though not good in some places, but better.' Obama said he is advising young people to be persistent because 'typically progress happens in steps and in increments.' In dealing with something 'as deeply rooted as racism or bias in any society, you've got to have vigilance, but you have to recognize that it's going to take some time, and you just have to be steady so that you don't give up when you don't get all the way there,' Obama said. New York has become the focal point of demonstrations demanding justice for black men who have died at the hands of white police officers in recent weeks. 'We have to have an honest conversation in this country about the history of racism, and we have to have an honest conversation about the problems that have caused parents to feel that their children may be in danger in their interactions with police, when in fact police are there to protect them,' Mayor De Blasio told ABC News. New York Mayor Bill de Blasio, pictured with his wife Chirlane McCray in April, has said that the US is facing 'centuries of racism' following protests in the city last week. 'Our police keep us safe, and yet there's been not just decades of problems, but a history of centuries of racism that undergirds this reality.' De Blasio, who is white and married to a black woman with whom he has mixed-race children, added: 'We have to retrain police forces in how to work with communities differently, and we have to work on things like body cameras that will provide a different level of transparency and accountability.' 'This is something systemic, and we bluntly have to talk about the historical racial dynamics underlying (it).' Speaking from personal experience, de Blasio told ABC that he feared for his son's safety in dealing with the police. 'What parents have done for decades with children of color, especially young men of color, is train them to be very careful when they have a connection with a police officer, when they have an encounter with a police officer,' he said. 'It's different for a white child; it's just a reality in this country.' 'And with Dante, very early on, my son, we used to say, look, if a police officer stops you, do everything he tells you to do, don't move suddenly, don't reach for your cellphone, because we knew, sadly, there is a greater chance it might be misinterpreted if it was a young man of color.' He continued: 'There's that fear that there could be that moment of misunderstanding with a young man of color, and that young man may never come back.' New York has been the focal point of demonstrations in the past week following the decision by a grand jury not to indict the officer involved in the death of Eric Garner. Last weekend, protesters walked through various locations in the city, including Union Square, to protest the recent police killings.

New York was die middelpunt van betogings die afgelope week ná die besluit van 'n groot jurie om nie die beampte wat by die dood van Eric Garner betrokke was, aan te kla nie. Originally from Britain, Jeter was deported from the U.S. for his involvement with New York gangs and convictions for attempted robbery. In prison, he created a profile on Inmate-Connection, expressing his desire for companionship. The attack involved a makeshift weapon; one warden suffered a significant neck wound, and the other sustained cuts. Authorities are investigating, and Jeter has been moved to another high-security facility. Steve Gillan of the Prison Officers Association highlighted the increasing assaults on prison staff, urging stronger legal actions. The Prison Service affirmed its zero-tolerance policy regarding violence against its staff.

article_content: By Martha De Lacey PUBLISHED: 10:55 EST, January 9, 2013 UPDATED: 12:23 EST, January 9, 2013 Most people would find juggling two adolescent children, a Harley Street therapy practice, and a relationship time-consuming enough. But Louise Van der Velde, a 38-year-old widow from Camberley, Surrey, is not like most people. After the death of her doctor husband nine years ago, the mother-of-two decided she wanted more than one man in her life and that marriage was for 'mugs'. Now, the sex therapist maintains relationships with three men: a property tycoon, a multimillionaire who runs a solar panel company in Dubai, and an electrician. She has written a book telling others how they could do the same. Louise Van der Velde practices as a sexual and relationship expert in Harley Street and at her own retreat in Marbella, Spain. 'There are simply too many great men out there for me to settle for just one,' said the mother, who says each man knows they are not in an exclusive relationship. Louise, who practices as a sexual and relationship expert both in Harley Street and at her own retreat in Marbella, Spain, says her model won't work for everyone, but it has brought her happiness. She said: 'If you are having great sex and great relationships, all areas of your life are impacted positively. Some people find happiness in a relationship with one person. I have it with three.' Insisting she doesn't feel cheap sharing her body with more than one lover, Louise added: 'The fact is, I have a deep connection with all three men. Yes, I have sex with all of them but not at the same time. I wouldn't say that I have a ridiculously high sex drive. The average person has sex two or three times a week; I might be a little bit more than that, but not much more.' Louise says she is completely happy with her three lovers, as are they. Maintaining that she shields her two children—a daughter aged 11 and a son of 16—from her private life, Louise explained how she has been seeing the 40-year-old Dubai-based solar panel tycoon for the past six years after meeting by chance at an airport. 'He is aware that I see other men and is quite happy with the situation,' she said. She was introduced to lover number two—a London-based property tycoon in his 30s who appeared on Channel 4's Secret Millionaire—by a mutual friend, and they have been seeing each other for a year. 'He is very sexy and dynamic; I have always been attracted to high-achieving men,' she said. Lover number three is a young electrician who lives near her in Surrey and is happy to visit when she asks. 'He is great; we met by chance after chatting on the train to London. He is quite young and completely different from my other two lovers.' Louise claims the arrangement works because she has always been completely honest with her partners. 'I have counselled numerous people and have seen how it can work for them too. We are all on a different journey. You have to follow your gut feelings to achieve happiness.' Louise also believes many people are 'deluding themselves' when they say they are happily married. She said: 'The controversial truth is that the state of marriage—and, more importantly, the monogamy it entails—isn't really working for most people in today's society. Okay, it works for some, and that's wonderful when it does bring happiness. I've got the utmost respect for their choice. But the sad reality is that many people simply cannot live up to the expectations of life and sex with a single partner. And that almost inevitably causes cheating, marital breakdowns, recriminations, divorce, spousal abandonment, and misery.' Louise has outlined her new model for relationships in a new book, Decent Proposal. She explained: 'What if the fairytale version of love and marriage we stumbled upon in storybooks when we were kids is simply incompatible with the modern world? Look around you. How many friends are now on their second or even third marriages? Be honest. Count them. The sad fact is that too many relationships are filled with deceit, insecurity, or just plain apathy, as the foundations at their core were wrong from the start. So why in the 21st century do we still keep trying to make an outdated model of relationships work? Why don't we have the honesty and integrity to admit we all want a bit more out of life?' Saying that 'many people simply don't have time for the old model of relationship', Louise feels many people are instead choosing to spend time with lots of people they like. Louise Van der Velde has now written a book explaining how other people can use her 'relationship model'. 'Opening the door to your heart so wide it's okay for people to come and go as they choose isn't always easy, and it's not for everyone. I understand that. That way, we can make ourselves and others happy without the pressures or expectations that arise from a traditional, and, I would argue, outdated, one-man, one-woman relationship. It seems so obvious to me now. I'm living the new model of relationships, and I can assure you, it not only works, it'll help you reach new heights of intimacy that you may not have ever previously dreamed possible.' Decent Proposal by Louise Van der Velde is available on Kindle via Amazon. Louise's website is www.pleasureprofessor.com.

Maar die hartseer realiteit is dat baie mense eenvoudig nie aan die verwagtinge van die lewe en seks met 'n enkele maat kan voldoen nie. article_content: Shirley Sherrod, a former employee of the Department of Agriculture, announced plans on Thursday to file a lawsuit against conservative blogger Andrew Breitbart. This action stems from Breitbart's posting of an edited video. The video gave the impression that Sherrod admitted to discriminating against a white farmer who was seeking assistance. The edited clip presented Sherrod addressing a chapter of the NAACP. When questioned about potential legal action, she affirmed, 'I will definitely do it.' Sherrod's statements were made during an appearance at the National Association of Black Journalists convention held in San Diego, California. Sherrod stated that Breitbart 'had to know that he was targeting me.' She added, 'At this point, he hasn't apologized. I don't want it at this point, and he'll definitely hear from me.' Breitbart has not yet issued a response to requests for comments. Breitbart defended his decision to release the Sherrod video by claiming it exposed the NAACP's tolerance of racist behavior within its own organization. This accusation followed similar charges made by the civil rights group against the conservative Tea Party movement. Breitbart told CNN's John King, 'This was not about Shirley Sherrod.' Brent Bozell, leader of the conservative Media Research Center, argued on Thursday that Sherrod should be the one issuing an apology. Bozell stated, 'Andrew Breitbart is going to be fine. He's done nothing wrong.' He also questioned who was 'putting her up to this' and accused her of 'lying about Fox News,' which allegedly pushed the story before all the facts were known. Bozell further stated, 'I'm also waiting for Ms. Sherrod to publicly apologize for accusing anyone opposed to nationalized healthcare of being racist... Last time I checked, that was more than half the country.' The controversy surrounding the edited clip triggered a hasty reaction, leading to Sherrod's forced resignation. However, it was later revealed that her full speech emphasized moving beyond race and how the incident had changed her perspective. The original incident occurred 24 years prior to her employment at the USDA. After the full context of her remarks became clear, Sherrod received an official apology from the USDA and a phone call from President Barack Obama. Subsequently, Sherrod was offered another position at the Agriculture Department. Earlier on Thursday, Obama stated that Sherrod 'deserves better than what happened last week.' Speaking at a National Urban League conference in Washington, Obama described the claim of racism against her as 'bogus.' He acknowledged that 'many are to blame' for the ensuing reaction, 'including my own administration.' Obama recounted telling Sherrod that her story 'is exactly the kind of story we need to hear in America (because) we all have our biases.'

article_content: A Flybe aircraft experienced a delay exceeding two hours because of an unexpected repair needed on its tail wing. The 15 individuals aboard the Loganair flight, which was en route from Edinburgh to Stornoway and operated by Flybe, were held up. The plane remained grounded on the Edinburgh airport tarmac for a couple of hours while technicians addressed a tiny hole located within the plane's de-icing apparatus. According to the Daily Record, Reverend Iver Martin, who was a passenger, voiced his disapproval, stating that passengers were informed of the patching of a hole in the tail wing while awaiting glue to dry. He questioned the acceptability of this practice, emphatically rejecting it. A Loganair representative clarified that the delay stemmed from necessary safety measures, prioritizing the well-being of those traveling. The representative added that a pre-flight check before the scheduled 5 pm departure of flight BE6147 revealed a problem in the plane's de-icing system, requiring an adhesive patch and subsequent curing period. Departure was then cleared at 7:23 pm. The spokesperson stressed the airline's unwavering commitment to passenger safety above all else.

article_content: He was hunted and harried, but Lewis Hamilton ultimately won the Spanish Grand Prix—his fourth consecutive victory, which propelled him to the top of the World Championship standings. Back in the Mercedes team headquarters, Niki Lauda, the Mercedes chairman, a seasoned observer in his red hat, emphatically stated in his characteristic Austrian style that Hamilton is simply unbeatable. This assertion was mildly challenged in the final laps of the race when Nico Rosberg, aided by fresher, faster tires, came within six-tenths of a second of overtaking him. Had the race continued for a couple more laps, he might have succeeded. This dramatic conclusion capped a race that unfolded slowly on the Barcelona track, known for its procession-like nature. Hamilton, while leading the championship by three points for the first time in nearly two years, expressed less than ecstatic feelings. ‘I wasn’t fast enough today,’ he admitted. ‘Nico was quicker.’ Hamilton was being self-critical (and perhaps a bit testy during earlier radio communications). However, he deserved the win for outperforming Rosberg in the crucial moments of the weekend: securing pole position and executing a cleaner start to maintain his lead into the first corner. Lauda, pleased with his team’s fourth one-two finish of the season, declared: ‘Lewis Hamilton is unbeatable. It’s very simple. He’s improving with every race. He makes no mistakes. He’s got a strong personality and is focused. Nico tried every trick today to get him, and he did a good job, but he couldn’t pass him.’ ‘Nico is aware of Lewis’s driving level because they drive the same car. And Nico will continue to fight, which is most important. If Nico keeps pushing himself to beat Lewis, both cars will go quicker, which is a big advantage. So I’m in a comfortable situation — outstanding performance by Lewis and Nico trying to catch up.’ Lauda continued: ‘My strategy is simple. We don’t interfere with who is winning. We let our drivers race from beginning to end. So far, nothing bad has happened. If there is no third driver in championship contention, I’m completely relaxed.’ ‘Then they can drive over each other, and whoever survives becomes the world champion. This is my dream. But we’re not there yet. When we are, it’s going to be warfare.’ Whether it becomes that contentious depends on Rosberg’s ability to consistently match Hamilton’s performance. If he doesn’t in the upcoming races, starting with Monaco in two weeks, Hamilton’s dominance may be insurmountable. Rosberg commented: ‘I wasn’t close enough to attempt a pass. Another lap, and I would have been. So I’m a bit disappointed. Still, it was second place, I am close in the championship, and there are many more races to go.’ ‘The start was poor, which is a weakness at the moment. But there are many positives to take away, and I am fully motivated.’ Mercedes’ team dominance remains unchallenged after the three-week break and the start of the European season. The Mercedes cars finished more than 49 seconds ahead of Daniel Ricciardo’s Red Bull, who was initially delayed by Valtteri Bottas’s Williams. The actual gap is six-tenths of a second per lap, according to Red Bull team principal Christian Horner. Some questioned Hamilton’s decision to move from McLaren to Mercedes in 2013. However, he correctly identified their potential as a ‘super team’ in development. McLaren, meanwhile, lost Mercedes as partners and had not yet finalized a deal with Honda, which takes effect next season. ‘I feel truly blessed to be part of this team,’ Hamilton said. ‘It is unreal.’ The gap between Mercedes and McLaren was evident as Jenson Button and Kevin Magnussen were comprehensively lapped, an unacceptable situation for a team of McLaren’s caliber. Ferrari also struggled, with Kimi Raikkonen being lapped. At least Fernando Alonso was spared the additional humiliation of being lapped on his home track. Sebastian Vettel’s drive probably stood out as the best of the day. He started 15th due to a gearbox penalty but advanced to fourth. His boss, Horner, has extensive experience with dominating seasons. When asked if Mercedes would win all 19 races, he replied: ‘Possible but improbable.’

'Terug in die Mercedes-span se hoofkwartier het Niki Lauda, die Mercedes-voorsitter, 'n ervare waarnemer in sy rooi hoed, in sy kenmerkende Oostenrykse styl nadruklik verklaar dat Hamilton eenvoudig onverbeterlik is.' 'Hierdie bewering is effens uitgedaag in die laaste rondtes van die wedren toe Nico Rosberg, gehelp deur varser, vinniger bande, binne ses-tiendes van 'n sekonde gekom het om hom verby te steek. As die wedren nog 'n paar rondtes aangehou het, sou hy dalk daarin geslaag het.' 'Hierdie dramatiese gevolgtrekking het 'n wedren afgesluit wat stadig ontvou het op die Barcelona-baan, bekend vir sy prosessie-agtige aard.' 'Hamilton, terwyl hy vir die eerste keer in byna twee jaar met drie punte die kampioenskap gelei het, het minder as uitbundige gevoelens uitgespreek. 'Ek was vandag nie vinnig genoeg nie,' het hy erken. 'Nico was vinniger.' 'Hamilton was selfkrities (en miskien 'n bietjie krapperig tydens vroeëre radiokommunikasie). Hy het egter die oorwinning verdien omdat hy Rosberg in die deurslaggewende oomblikke van die naweek oortref het: 'n voorposisie verseker en 'n skoner begin uitgevoer het om sy voorsprong in die eerste draai te behou.' 'Lauda, tevrede met sy span se vierde een-twee-eindpunt van die seisoen, het verklaar: 'Lewis Hamilton is onverbeterlik. Dit is baie eenvoudig. Hy verbeter met elke wedren. Hy maak geen foute nie. Hy het 'n sterk persoonlikheid en is gefokus. Nico het vandag elke truuk probeer om hom te kry, en hy het 'n goeie werk gedoen, maar hy kon hom nie verbygaan nie.' 'Nico is bewus van Lewis se bestuursvlak omdat hulle dieselfde motor bestuur. En Nico sal aanhou veg, wat die belangrikste is. As Nico aanhou om homself te druk om Lewis te klop, sal albei motors vinniger ry, wat 'n groot voordeel is. So ek is in 'n gemaklike situasie — uitstekende prestasie deur Lewis en Nico wat probeer inhaal.' 'Lauda het voortgegaan: 'My strategie is eenvoudig. Ons meng nie in met wie wen nie. Ons laat ons bestuurders van begin tot einde jaag. Tot dusver het niks slegs gebeur nie. As daar geen derde bestuurder in die kampioenskapstryd is nie, is ek heeltemal ontspanne.' 'Dan kan hulle oor mekaar ry, en wie ook al oorleef, word die wêreldkampioen. Dit is my droom. Maar ons is nog nie daar nie. As ons daar is, gaan dit oorlog wees.' 'Of dit so omstrede word, hang af van Rosberg se vermoë om Hamilton se prestasie konsekwent te ewenaar. As hy dit nie in die komende wedrenne doen nie, beginnende met Monaco oor twee weke, kan Hamilton se oorheersing onoorbrugbaar wees.' 'Rosberg het gesê: 'Ek was nie na genoeg om 'n poging aan te wend om verby te steek nie. Nog 'n rondte, en ek sou gewees het. So ek is 'n bietjie teleurgesteld. Tog was dit die tweede plek, ek is na in die kampioenskap, en daar is nog baie wedrenne wat voorlê.' 'Die begin was swak, wat tans 'n swakpunt is. Maar daar is baie positiewe dinge om weg te neem, en ek is ten volle gemotiveerd.' 'Mercedes se spanheerskappy bly onbetwis na die drie weke lange breek en die begin van die Europese seisoen. Die Mercedes-motors het meer as 49 sekondes voor Daniel Ricciardo se Red Bull geëindig, wat aanvanklik vertraag is deur Valtteri Bottas se Williams. Die werklike gaping is ses-tiendes van 'n sekonde per rondte, volgens Red Bull-spanhoof Christian Horner.' 'Sommige het Hamilton se besluit bevraagteken om in 2013 van McLaren na Mercedes te verskuif. Hy het egter korrek hul potensiaal as 'n 'super-span' in wording geïdentifiseer. McLaren het intussen Mercedes as vennote verloor en nog nie 'n ooreenkoms met Honda gefinaliseer nie, wat volgende seisoen in werking tree.' 'Ek voel waarlik geseënd om deel te wees van hierdie span,' het Hamilton gesê. 'Dit is onwerklik.' 'Die gaping tussen Mercedes en McLaren was duidelik toe Jenson Button en Kevin Magnussen omvattend ge-lap is, 'n onaanvaarbare situasie vir 'n span van McLaren se kaliber. Ferrari het ook gesukkel, met Kimi Raikkonen wat ge-lap is. Fernando Alonso is ten minste die verdere vernedering gespaar om op sy tuisbaan ge-lap te word.' 'Sebastian Vettel se bestuur het waarskynlik uitgestaan as die beste van die dag. Hy het 15de begin weens 'n ratkasstraf, maar tot vierde gevorder. Sy baas, Horner, het uitgebreide ondervinding met oorheersende seisoene. Toe hy gevra is of Mercedes al 19 wedrenne sou wen, het hy geantwoord: 'Moontlik, maar onwaarskynlik.''

article_content: Adam Walker, the newly appointed head of the BNP, is scheduled to visit the Yasukuni Shrine in Tokyo. This planned visit has drawn criticism, with many accusing Walker of disrespecting British war veterans. The shrine is a contentious symbol, as it commemorates Japanese war criminals who were responsible for the deaths of numerous Allied soldiers and civilians during World War II. Veterans' groups and former soldiers who endured harsh conditions as forced laborers are expressing their anger over Walker's intentions. Walker, who is 45 years old, succeeded Nick Griffin as the leader of the British National Party last week. Despite the BNP's claim of being a 'patriotic' party that honors British military personnel, the Yasukuni Shrine remains a powerful reminder of Japan's militaristic history. Among those honored at the shrine are 14 Japanese military leaders and politicians convicted of heinous war crimes by international tribunals. Last night, veterans voiced their dismay at Walker's decision to visit the shrine. Robert Hucklesby, 93, a former prisoner of war, recalled his experiences as a forced laborer on the River Kwai railway. John Giddings, 91, chairman of the Burma Star Association, also criticized Walker's plans. Walker, who is from Spennymoor, Co Durham, is married to a Japanese woman and speaks fluent Japanese after living in Japan for several years. He previously visited the shrine in 2010, coinciding with the anniversary of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, at the invitation of the Nippon Issuikai group. The shrine commemorates war criminals who oversaw the brutal treatment of British prisoners of war. In the past, Walker faced a ban from teaching after being found guilty of misconduct. A BNP spokesperson defended Walker's visit as a sign of respect and a step toward reconciliation, stating that Walker does not condone war crimes and sees no contradiction in honoring both 'innocents and enemies' who died in war.

article_content: A new short film series will soon feature world-renowned tennis star Novak Djokovic sharing previously untold stories from his life. The series, titled 'Made By', is a collaboration between Djokovic and Australian winery Jacob's Creek, filmed in his hometown of Belgrade, Serbia. These films, which follow a documentary format, will highlight the people and places that contributed to Djokovic's rise to tennis stardom. The film series, directed by emerging US filmmaker Keith 'Keef' Ehrlich, explores Djokovic's origins, from growing up in war-torn Serbia to the impact of his initial coach, Jelena Gencic, and his major Grand Slam victories at the Australian Open and Wimbledon. According to a trailer released on Monday, Djokovic stated that his greatest challenge was an internal one. He added that partnering with Jacob's Creek has provided him with the platform to share his story, revealing the inspirations and influences that have shaped him. The 'Made By' films, set to launch globally on January 13, 2015, represent the next phase of the successful Jacob's Creek Open Film Series, previously featuring tennis icon Andre Agassi. Derek Oliver, Global Marketing Director at Jacob's Creek, noted the company's longstanding association with professional tennis and highlighted Djokovic's embodiment of the brand's authentic spirit. He stated that both Jacob's Creek and Djokovic are proud of their 'Made By' stories, and the partnership aims to share Djokovic's journey with the world. Jacob's Creek's partnership with Djokovic is part of their global tennis sponsorship platform, which includes events such as the Australian Open, Wimbledon, and the China Open.

Hierdie films, wat 'n dokumentêre formaat volg, sal die mense en plekke uitlig wat bygedra het tot Djokovic se opgang na tennissterre. Die filmreeks, onder regie van die opkomende Amerikaanse filmmaker Keith 'Keef' Ehrlich, ondersoek Djokovic se oorsprong, vanaf sy grootwordjare in 'n oorloggeteisterde Serwië tot die impak van sy eerste afrigter, Jelena Gencic, en sy groot Grand Slam-oorwinnings by die Australiese Ope en Wimbledon. Volgens 'n lokprent wat Maandag vrygestel is, het Djokovic gesê dat sy grootste uitdaging 'n interne een was. Hy het bygevoeg dat sy vennootskap met Jacob's Creek hom die platform gebied het om sy storie te deel en die inspirasies en invloede te onthul wat hom gevorm het. Die 'Made By'-films, wat op 13 Januarie 2015 wêreldwyd bekendgestel is, verteenwoordig die volgende fase van die suksesvolle Jacob's Creek Open Film Series, met die tennisikoon Andre Agassi. Derek Oliver, Globale Bemarkingsdirekteur by Jacob's Creek, het kennis geneem van die maatskappy se jarelange verbintenis met professionele tennis en het Djokovic se vergestalting van die handelsmerk se outentieke gees uitgelig. Hy het gesê dat Jacob's Creek en Djokovic trots is op hul 'Made By'-stories, en dat die vennootskap ten doel het om Djokovic se reis met die wêreld te deel. Jacob's Creek se vennootskap met Djokovic is deel van hul wêreldwye tennisborgskap platform, wat geleenthede soos die Australiese Ope, Wimbledon en die China Ope insluit.

article_content: Yorkshire’s celebrations of their first championship title in 13 years were disrupted when their captain, Andrew Gale, was accused of using racial language on the field. Gale is the first county cricketer to face such an accusation. The newly crowned champions immediately vowed to defend Gale, who is accused of abusing Lancashire’s Ashwell Prince during the third day of a heated Roses match on September 3. The severity of the situation became clear when the ECB banned Gale not only for two games but also from participating in the championship trophy presentation at Trent Bridge the previous week. Yorkshire's fears were confirmed when it was announced that Gale would face a disciplinary hearing in London the following week, potentially facing a Level Three or Four charge for racial verbal abuse. The charge will depend on what Gale said to Prince during a tense moment at Old Trafford, a passage of play that reignited the rivalry between the two teams. Reportedly, Prince told Gale to 'f*** off back to your fielding position' when Gale was attempting to squeeze in one more over near the end of the day, seeking a victory. Gale allegedly responded by telling Prince to 'f*** off back to your own country you Kolpak f*****.' Yorkshire insists this should not be considered racist and is preparing a legal defense against the ECB. The Kolpak regulation concerns Prince’s status as a non-overseas player, a rule overturned in European courts by Maros Kolpak. However, the key issue is whether the phrase 'go back to your own country' is deemed racist. Yorkshire will question whether the same charge would apply if those words were directed at a white South African, but the ECB is committed to addressing what it views as a serious matter. The ECB initiated the Cricket Discipline Commission review after umpires Steve Garrett and Steve O’Shaughnessy reported Gale for a Level Two offence under the ECB code of conduct, citing 'language or gesture that is obscene or of a serious insulting nature.' Gale’s previous disciplinary action for dissent earlier in the season triggered a two-match ban, preventing him from playing in the championship decider against Nottinghamshire. The escalation of the accusation has transformed it into a more significant issue. A Level Three charge was initially brought against England’s Jimmy Anderson after a clash with India’s Ravindra Jadeja, although that case lacked any suggestion of racist abuse and was dismissed by the International Cricket Council. Now, Gale, a former England Lions captain, is fighting to protect his reputation over the interpretation of words that he and his county maintain should not be interpreted as racist. The ECB, criticized for preventing Gale from collecting the trophy, appears determined to make an example of a county captain known for dissent. Some argue that the ECB has displayed double standards, noting their reluctance to intervene when Moeen Ali was booed by Indian supporters at Edgbaston in what appeared to be racist abuse related to his Pakistani heritage. Gale was expected to parade the championship trophy at Headingley during their final match against Somerset. Instead, he will be working to salvage his reputation.

Gale is die eerste graafskap krieketspeler wat so 'n beskuldiging in die gesig staar. Die nuut gekroonde kampioene het onmiddellik belowe om Gale te verdedig, wat daarvan beskuldig word dat hy Lancashire se Ashwell Prince mishandel het tydens die derde dag van 'n verhitte Roses-wedstryd op 3 September. Die erns van die situasie het duidelik geword toe die ECB Gale nie net vir twee wedstryde verban het nie, maar ook van deelname aan die kampioenskapstrofee-aanbieding by Trent Bridge die vorige week. Yorkshire se vrese is bevestig toe aangekondig is dat Gale die volgende week 'n dissiplinêre verhoor in Londen sou ondergaan, moontlik 'n vlak drie- of vierklag in die gesig staar vir rassistiese verbale mishandeling. Die aanklag sal afhang van wat Gale vir Prince gesê het tydens 'n gespanne oomblik by Old Trafford, 'n spel wat die wedywering tussen die twee spanne weer laat opvlam het. Na bewering het Prince vir Gale gesê om 'f*** off back to your fielding position' toe Gale aan die einde van die dag nog 'n boulbeurt probeer inprop het en 'n oorwinning probeer behaal het. Gale het na bewering geantwoord deur vir Prince te sê om 'f*** off back to your own country you Kolpak f*****.' Yorkshire dring daarop aan dat dit nie as rassisties beskou moet word nie en berei 'n regsverweer teen die ECB voor. Die Kolpak-regulasie gaan oor Prince se status as 'n nie-oorsese speler, 'n reël wat in Europese howe deur Maros Kolpak omvergewerp is. Die kernvraag is egter of die frase 'gaan terug na jou eie land' as rassisties beskou word. Yorkshire sal bevraagteken of dieselfde aanklag sou geld as daardie woorde aan 'n wit Suid-Afrikaner gerig sou word, maar die ECB is daartoe verbind om aan te spreek wat hy as 'n ernstige saak beskou. Die ECB het die Cricket Discipline Commission-hersiening begin nadat skeidsregters Steve Garrett en Steve O'Shaughnessy Gale aangemeld het vir 'n vlak twee-oortreding ingevolge die ECB-gedragskode, met verwysing na 'taal of gebare wat obsene of van 'n ernstige beledigende aard is'. Gale se vorige dissiplinêre optrede vir verskil vroeër in die seisoen het 'n verbod van twee wedstryde veroorsaak, wat hom verhinder het om in die kampioenskapwedstryd teen Nottinghamshire te speel. Die eskalasie van die beskuldiging het dit in 'n belangriker kwessie verander. 'n Vlak drie-aanklag is aanvanklik teen Engeland se Jimmy Anderson aanhangig gemaak ná 'n botsing met Indië se Ravindra Jadeja, hoewel daardie saak geen suggestie van rassistiese mishandeling bevat het nie en deur die Internasionale Krieketraad van die hand gewys is. Nou veg Gale, 'n voormalige Engeland Lions-kaptein, om sy reputasie te beskerm oor die interpretasie van woorde wat hy en sy graafskap volhou nie as rassisties vertolk moet word nie. Die ECB, wat gekritiseer is omdat hy Gale verhinder het om die trofee te ontvang, blyk vasbeslote te wees om 'n voorbeeld te maak van 'n graafskapkaptein wat bekend is vir verskil. Sommige voer aan dat die ECB dubbele standaarde getoon het, en let op hul onwilligheid om in te gryp toe Moeen Ali deur Indiese ondersteuners by Edgbaston uitgejou is in wat blykbaar rassistiese mishandeling was wat verband hou met sy Pakistanse erfenis. Daar is van Gale verwag om die kampioenskapstrofee by Headingley te paradeer tydens hul laaste wedstryd teen Somerset. In plaas daarvan sal hy daaraan werk om sy reputasie te red.

article_content: This upcoming Sunday, the Fourth of July, marks the 234th anniversary of the United States, a celebration fueled by millions of hot dogs, plenty of beer, and a dazzling display of fireworks. The National Hot Dog & Sausage Council's Tom Super estimates that Americans will devour 150 million hot dogs. If lined up end-to-end, these wieners would stretch across the country five times, linking San Diego, California, with Washington, D.C. Preferences for topping those dogs vary widely. About a third of hot dog fans favor mustard, almost a quarter opt for ketchup, 17 percent prefer chili, while 9 percent enjoy relish, and 7 percent like onions. In Chicago, the classic dog is adorned with yellow mustard, dark green relish, chopped raw onion, tomato slices, and a sprinkle of celery salt, according to the council. Kansas City goes for sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese. At Minute Maid Park in Houston, chili, cheese, and jalapenos reign supreme. However, New Yorkers consume more hot dogs than any other group, topping them simply with steamed onions and mustard. Some of those dogs will be eaten during Nathan's famous hot dog eating contest at Coney Island in New York, a tradition since 1916, where contestants have only 12 minutes. Joey Chestnut set last year's record by downing 68 hot dogs and buns. The USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service reports that Iowa provides about one in four hot dogs and pork sausages eaten during the holiday. For those grilling out, the beef hot dogs, steaks, and burgers are likely to originate from Texas. Barbecue or fried chicken often comes from Georgia, Arkansas, North Carolina, Alabama, Mississippi, or Texas. Baked beans, a popular side dish, likely started in North Dakota. The tomatoes are likely from Florida or California, and the corn on the cob probably grew in Florida, California, Georgia, Washington, or New York. All this feasting will be complemented by beer. Jeff Becker, President of the Beer Institute, notes that the Independence Day period is the top time for beer sales in the U.S., according to IRI Infoscan data. The American Pyrotechnics Association anticipates robust fireworks sales, despite economic conditions. They state that the Fourth of July sees more fireworks ignited than any other celebration worldwide, with 213.2 million pounds used in 2008. However, this pyrotechnic enthusiasm comes with risks. The Consumer Product Safety Commission reported two deaths and about 9,000 injuries requiring emergency room visits last year due to fireworks. Serious burns and eye injuries are the most common, and even sparklers, seemingly harmless, can reach temperatures of 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Interestingly, two Founding Fathers, John Adams and Thomas Jefferson, both of whom played pivotal roles in American independence, also died on July 4th. While they ran against each other in a contentious presidential race in 1800, their friendship was later restored. Both men died on July 4, 1826, the 50th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence. James Monroe, America's fifth president, also died on July 4, 1831.

New Yorkers eet egter meer worsbroodjies as enige ander groep, en beleg dit eenvoudig met gestoomde uie en mosterd. Van hierdie worsbroodjies sal tydens Nathan se bekende worsbroodjie-eetkompetisie by Coney Island in New York verslind word, 'n tradisie wat sedert 1916 bestaan, waar deelnemers net 12 minute het. Joey Chestnut het verlede jaar die rekord opgestel deur 68 worsbroodjies en broodjies in te sluk. Die USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service rapporteer dat Iowa ongeveer een uit elke vier worsbroodjies en varkworsies verskaf wat gedurende die vakansiedag verorber word. Die beesvleis worsbroodjies, steaks en hamburgers wat gebraai word, kom waarskynlik van Texas af. Braaivleis of gebraaide hoender kom dikwels van Georgia, Arkansas, Noord-Carolina, Alabama, Mississippi of Texas. Gebakte bone, 'n gewilde bygereg, het waarskynlik in Noord-Dakota ontstaan. Jeff Becker, President van die Beer Institute, sê dat die Onafhanklikheidsdag-periode die beste tyd vir bierverkope in die VSA is, volgens IRI Infoscan-data. Die American Pyrotechnics Association verwag goeie vuurwerkverkope, ten spyte van die ekonomiese omstandighede. Hulle sê dat die vierde Julie meer vuurwerke sien as enige ander viering wêreldwyd, met 213,2 miljoen pond wat in 2008 gebruik is. Hierdie vuurwerk-geesdrif hou egter risiko's in. Die Consumer Product Safety Commission het verlede jaar twee sterftes en ongeveer 9 000 beserings aangemeld wat noodkamerbesoeke weens vuurwerke vereis het. Erge brandwonde en oogbeserings is die mees algemene, en selfs sterretjies, wat skynbaar onskadelik is, kan temperature van 2 000 grade Fahrenheit bereik. Interessant genoeg, twee Stigtersvaders, John Adams en Thomas Jefferson, wat albei 'n belangrike rol in die Amerikaanse onafhanklikheid gespeel het, het ook op 4 Julie gesterf. Alhoewel hulle in 1800 in 'n taai presidensiële wedloop teen mekaar gehardloop het, is hulle vriendskap later herstel. Beide mans is op 4 Julie 1826 oorlede, die 50ste herdenking van die Onafhanklikheidsverklaring. James Monroe, Amerika se vyfde president, is ook op 4 Julie 1831 oorlede.

article_content: In Spain, archaeologists are reporting the unearthing of what they believe to be one of the oldest images of Jesus, notable for his lack of a beard. According to reports from Spain, the figure is etched onto a glass plate that has been dated to the 4th Century AD. The image shows Jesus accompanied by two apostles, thought to be Peter and Paul. What makes this scene remarkable is that Jesus’s appearance differs greatly from later representations; he is depicted without a beard, has short, curly hair, and is wearing what seems to be a philosopher's toga. This contrasts sharply with the commonly seen bearded Jesus with long, brown hair in traditional artwork. All three figures are shown with halos above their heads. It is believed that the plate, measuring 22cm in diameter, served as a vessel for Eucharistic bread during consecration in early Christian ceremonies. Fragments of the plate were discovered by scientists involved with the FORVM MMX project within the remains of a religious structure in the ancient city of Castulo, located in Andalusia, southern Spain. Marcelo Castro, who leads the FORVM MMX excavation, stated that the building was constructed in the latter part of the fourth century AD and was abandoned roughly a century later, as reported by The Local. This discovery has prompted scientists to 'reconsider the timeline of early Christianity in Spain,' according to Marcelo Castro, the project director, in a statement to El Mundo newspaper. The fragments were remarkably well-preserved; scientists have managed to piece together about 81 percent of the plate’s original surface. 'The scene is set within a celestial sphere, positioned between two palm trees, which, in Christian symbolism, represent immortality, the afterlife, and heaven,' ABC writes.
translated_content: In Spanje rapporteer argeoloë die ontdekking van wat hulle glo een van die oudste beelde van Jesus is, merkwaardig vir sy afwesigheid van 'n baard. Volgens berigte uit Spanje is die figuur op 'n glasplaat geëts wat uit die 4de eeu n.C. dateer. Die beeld wys Jesus vergesel van twee apostels, vermoedelik Petrus en Paulus. Wat hierdie toneel merkwaardig maak, is dat Jesus se voorkoms grootliks verskil van latere voorstellings; hy word uitgebeeld sonder 'n baard, het kort, krullerige hare, en dra wat blykbaar 'n filosoof se toga is. Dit kontrasteer skerp met die algemeen gesiene bebaarde Jesus met lang, bruin hare in tradisionele kunswerk. Al drie figure word getoon met stralekranse bo hul koppe. Daar word geglo dat die plaat, wat 22 cm in deursnee meet, gedien het as 'n houer vir Eucharistiese brood tydens die konsekrering in vroeë Christelike seremonies. Fragmente van die plaat is ontdek deur wetenskaplikes betrokke by die FORVM MMX-projek binne die oorblyfsels van 'n godsdienstige struktuur in die antieke stad Castulo, geleë in Andalusië, Suid-Spanje. Marcelo Castro, wat die FORVM MMX-opgrawing lei, het verklaar dat die gebou in die latere deel van die vierde eeu n.C. gebou is en ongeveer 'n eeu later verlaat is, soos gerapporteer deur The Local. Hierdie ontdekking het wetenskaplikes aangespoor om 'die tydlyn van vroeë Christendom in Spanje te heroorweeg,' volgens Marcelo Castro, die projekdirekteur, in 'n verklaring aan die El Mundo-koerant. Die fragmente was merkwaardig goed bewaar; wetenskaplikes het daarin geslaag om ongeveer 81 persent van die plaat se oorspronklike oppervlak saam te voeg. 'Die toneel speel af binne 'n hemelse sfeer, geposisioneer tussen twee palm bome, wat in Christelike simboliek onsterflikheid, die hiernamaals en die hemel verteenwoordig,' skryf ABC.
